subject: __CFStringCreateTaggedPointerString

observation.summary: The macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation export trie contains exactly three CF tagged-pointer string entry points: __CFStringCreateTaggedPointerString, __CFStringCreateIndirectASCIITaggedPointerString and __CFIndirectTaggedPointerStringGetContents. The CF-Lite mirror at revision dc54c6b contains none of these names, so this machinery postdates that snapshot.

claim: macOS 27 CoreFoundation exports __CFStringCreateTaggedPointerString and two sibling tagged-pointer string helpers, confirming an arm64 tagged-pointer fast path that is absent from the CF-Lite 1153.18 mirror; the tag bit layout itself is not observable from the export table.

cross_reference.label: CF-Lite CFString.c (no tagged-pointer code at this revision)

reproducer:
CF=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation
dyld_info -uuid "$CF"            # expect UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692
dyld_info -exports "$CF" | grep -E 'TaggedPointer'
